    WHEN p_need IS NULL THEN p_tip IS NULL

    WHEN p_need = 'building' THEN p_tip IN ('building', 'dungeon', 'site')
    WHEN p_need = 'room' THEN p_tip IN ('room', 'interior')
    ELSE FALSE
  END;
$$

      AND (
        p.gm_user_id = auth.uid()
        OR public.current_user_is_active_project_member(p.id)

  );

  SELECT EXISTS (
    SELECT 1 FROM public.projects p
    WHERE p.id = p_project_id AND p.gm_user_id = p_user_id
  )
  OR EXISTS (
    SELECT 1 FROM public.project_members pm
    WHERE pm.project_id = p_project_id
      AND pm.user_id = p_user_id
      AND pm.status = 'active'
      AND pm.role = 'gm'
  );
$$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.sagatree_pc_health(p_endurance integer, p_level integer) RETURNS integer LANGUAGE sql IMMUTABLE AS $$
  SELECT GREATEST(
    1,
    12 + 2 * LEAST(5, GREATEST(0, COALESCE(p_endurance, 1)))
      + 2 * public.sagatree_experience_bonus(COALESCE(p_level, 1))
  );
$$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.sagatree_pc_initiative_bonus(p_perception integer, p_awareness_rank integer, p_level integer) RETURNS integer LANGUAGE sql IMMUTABLE AS $$
  SELECT LEAST(5, GREATEST(0, COALESCE(p_perception, 1)))
       + LEAST(5, GREATEST(0, COALESCE(p_awareness_rank, 0)))
       + public.sagatree_applied_experience_bonus(
           LEAST(5, GREATEST(0, COALESCE(p_awareness_rank, 0))),
           COALESCE(p_level, 1)
         );
$$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.sagatree_session_has_director(p_session_id uuid, p_user_id uuid) RETURNS boolean LANGUAGE sql STABLE SECURITY DEFINER SET search_path TO 'public', 'pg_temp' AS $$
  SELECT EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM public.session_players sp
    WHERE sp.session_id = p_session_id
      AND sp.user_id = p_user_id
      AND jsonb_typeof(sp.capabilities) = 'array'
      AND sp.capabilities ? 'director'
  );
$$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.sagatree_skill_attribute_key(p_skill text) RETURNS text LANGUAGE sql IMMUTABLE AS $$
  SELECT CASE p_skill
    WHEN 'athletics' THEN 'strength'
    WHEN 'acrobatics' THEN 'dexterity'
    WHEN 'sleight' THEN 'dexterity'
    WHEN 'stealth' THEN 'dexterity'
    WHEN 'melee' THEN 'strength'
    WHEN 'ranged' THEN 'dexterity'
    WHEN 'awareness' THEN 'perception'
    WHEN 'insight' THEN 'perception'
    WHEN 'survival' THEN 'perception'
    WHEN 'investigation' THEN 'mind'
    WHEN 'knowledge' THEN 'mind'
    WHEN 'technology' THEN 'mind'
    WHEN 'medicine' THEN 'mind'
    WHEN 'driving' THEN 'dexterity'
    WHEN 'persuasion' THEN 'charisma'
    WHEN 'deception' THEN 'charisma'
    WHEN 'intimidation' THEN 'charisma'
    WHEN 'performance' THEN 'charisma'
    ELSE NULL
  END;
$$

  SELECT COALESCE(p_payload, '{}'::jsonb)
    - 'initiative'
    - 'hpCurrent'
    - 'hpMax'
    - 'round'
    - 'currentTurnIndex'
    - 'authoritative'
    - 'natural'
    - 'actions'
    - 'status'
    - 'schemaVersion';
$$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.seed_dornhain_gm_presence_character(p_project_id uuid, p_user_id uuid) RETURNS integer LANGUAGE plpgsql SECURITY DEFINER SET search_path TO 'public', 'pg_temp' AS $$
DECLARE
  v_exists BOOLEAN;
BEGIN
  IF p_project_id IS NULL OR p_user_id IS NULL THEN
    RETURN 0;
  END IF;

  SELECT EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM public.characters c
    WHERE c.owner_user_id = p_user_id
      AND (
        c.attributes->>'nativeAssetId' = 'gm.earthspirit'
        OR (
          lower(c.name) IN ('kosmischer erdgeist', 'erdgeist')
          AND COALESCE(c.project_id, p_project_id) = p_project_id
        )
      )
  ) INTO v_exists;

  IF v_exists THEN
    UPDATE public.characters c
    SET
      project_id = COALESCE(c.project_id, p_project_id),
      name = 'Kosmischer Erdgeist',
      description = COALESCE(
        NULLIF(BTRIM(c.description), ''),
        'GM-Presence · Kosmischer Erdgeist'
      ),
      class = COALESCE(NULLIF(BTRIM(c.class), ''), 'Weltgeist'),
      character_type = 'gm_presence',
      portrait_url = COALESCE(
        NULLIF(BTRIM(c.portrait_url), ''),
        '/assets/session/gm-earthspirit.jpg?v=1'
      ),
      attributes = COALESCE(c.attributes, '{}'::jsonb) || jsonb_build_object(
        'nativeAssetId', 'gm.earthspirit',
        'gmPresence', true
      ),
      updated_at = NOW()
    WHERE c.owner_user_id = p_user_id
      AND (
        c.attributes->>'nativeAssetId' = 'gm.earthspirit'
        OR (
          lower(c.name) IN ('kosmischer erdgeist', 'erdgeist')
          AND COALESCE(c.project_id, p_project_id) = p_project_id
        )
      );
    RETURN 0;
  END IF;

  INSERT INTO public.characters (
    owner_user_id,
    project_id,
    name,
    description,
    class,
    race,
    level,
    ruleset_key,
    attributes,
    skills,
    inventory,
    character_type,
    sheet_status,
    portrait_url,
    sagatree_profile
  ) VALUES (
    p_user_id,
    p_project_id,
    'Kosmischer Erdgeist',
    'GM-Presence · Kosmischer Erdgeist',
    'Weltgeist',
    'human',
    1,
    'sagatree-core',
    jsonb_build_object(
      'strength', 2,
      'dexterity', 2,
      'endurance', 3,
      'mind', 4,
      'perception', 3,
      'charisma', 3,
      'nativeAssetId', 'gm.earthspirit',
      'gmPresence', true,
      'nativeStarterSheetVersion', 1
    ),
    '{}'::jsonb,
    '[]'::jsonb,
    'gm_presence',
    'complete',
    '/assets/session/gm-earthspirit.jpg?v=1',
    jsonb_build_object(
      'nativeAssetId', 'gm.earthspirit',
      'gmPresence', true,
      'nativeStarterSheetVersion', 1
    )
  );

  RETURN 1;
END;
$$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.seed_dornhain_unified_atlas(p_world_profile_id uuid) RETURNS void LANGUAGE plpgsql SECURITY DEFINER SET search_path TO 'public', 'pg_temp' AS $$
DECLARE
  v_root UUID;
  v_settlement UUID;
  v_dornhain UUID;
  v_meta JSONB := public.build_dornhain_unified_generator_meta();
BEGIN
  IF p_world_profile_id IS NULL THEN
    RETURN;
  END IF;

  SELECT id INTO v_root
  FROM public.world_atlas_maps
  WHERE world_profile_id = p_world_profile_id AND kind = 'world'
  ORDER BY sort_order, created_at
  LIMIT 1;

  IF v_root IS NULL THEN
    INSERT INTO public.world_atlas_maps (
      world_profile_id, parent_map_id, kind, title, sort_order, bounds, generator_meta
    ) VALUES (
      p_world_profile_id, NULL, 'world', 'Welt', 10,
      '{"minX":0,"minY":0,"maxX":1000,"maxY":1000}'::jsonb,
      v_meta
    )
    RETURNING id INTO v_root;
  ELSE
    UPDATE public.world_atlas_maps
    SET
      title = CASE
        WHEN title IN (
          'Weltkarte',
          'Weltkarte (Unified)',
          'Kachelkarte (Legacy)',
          'Dornhain Übersicht (Unified)'
        ) OR btrim(title) = '' THEN 'Welt'
        ELSE title
      END,
      generator_meta = CASE
        WHEN COALESCE(generator_meta->'unifiedCanvas'->>'demoSeed', 'true') = 'true'
             AND COALESCE(jsonb_array_length(generator_meta->'unifiedCanvas'->'strokes'), 0) = 0
             AND COALESCE(jsonb_array_length(generator_meta->'unifiedCanvas'->'objects'), 0) = 0
          THEN v_meta
        WHEN generator_meta->'unifiedCanvas' IS NULL
          THEN v_meta
        WHEN COALESCE(generator_meta->>'seed', '') IN (
          'dornhain.unified.v1',
          'dornhain.unified.v2',
          'dornhain.unified.v3'
        )
          THEN v_meta
        ELSE generator_meta
      END,
      updated_at = NOW()
    WHERE id = v_root;
  END IF;

  INSERT INTO public.world_places (world_profile_id, parent_place_id, kind, name, description, status, seed_key, sort_order)
  VALUES (p_world_profile_id, NULL, 'settlement', 'Dornhain', 'Stadt in Donalu — Starterschauplatz', 'canonical', 'place.dornhain', 10)
  ON CONFLICT (world_profile_id, seed_key) DO UPDATE
    SET name = EXCLUDED.name, kind = EXCLUDED.kind, status = EXCLUDED.status, description = EXCLUDED.description;
  SELECT id INTO v_dornhain FROM public.world_places
  WHERE world_profile_id = p_world_profile_id AND seed_key = 'place.dornhain';

  INSERT INTO public.world_places (world_profile_id, parent_place_id, kind, name, description, status, seed_key, sort_order)
  VALUES
    (p_world_profile_id, v_dornhain, 'building', 'Taverne Zum Flüstern', 'Treffpunkt der Helden', 'canonical', 'loc.tavern', 20),
    (p_world_profile_id, v_dornhain, 'site', 'Marktplatz Dornhain', 'Gerüchte und Handel', 'canonical', 'loc.market', 30),
    (p_world_profile_id, v_dornhain, 'area', 'Schattenwald', 'Wald vor den Toren', 'canonical', 'loc.woods', 40),
    (p_world_profile_id, v_dornhain, 'dungeon', 'Krypta unter dem Hügel', 'GM-only Reliktort', 'canonical', 'loc.crypt', 50),
    (p_world_profile_id, v_dornhain, 'site', 'Banditenlager (falsche Spur)', 'Ablenkung', 'canonical', 'loc.bandit-camp', 60)
  ON CONFLICT (world_profile_id, seed_key) DO UPDATE SET
    parent_place_id = COALESCE(EXCLUDED.parent_place_id, public.world_places.parent_place_id),
    name = EXCLUDED.name,
    kind = EXCLUDED.kind,
    description = COALESCE(EXCLUDED.description, public.world_places.description),
    status = EXCLUDED.status;

  SELECT id INTO v_settlement
  FROM public.world_atlas_maps
  WHERE world_profile_id = p_world_profile_id
    AND kind = 'settlement'
    AND (title ILIKE '%Dornhain%' OR generator_meta->>'placeSeedKey' = 'place.dornhain')
  ORDER BY sort_order
  LIMIT 1;

  IF v_settlement IS NULL THEN
    INSERT INTO public.world_atlas_maps (
      world_profile_id, parent_map_id, kind, title, sort_order, bounds, generator_meta
    ) VALUES (
      p_world_profile_id, v_root, 'settlement', 'Dornhain (Stadt)', 20,
      '{"minX":0,"minY":0,"maxX":400,"maxY":400}'::jsonb,
      jsonb_build_object(
        'engine', 'unified_canvas',
        'placeSeedKey', 'place.dornhain',
        'unifiedCanvas', jsonb_build_object(
          'format', 'sagatree-unified-atlas-v1',
          'demoSeed', false,
          'layers', jsonb_build_object(
            'terrain', true, 'roads', true, 'region', true, 'city', true,
            'interior', true, 'drawings', true, 'objects', true, 'grid', false
          ),
          'strokes', '[]'::jsonb,
          'objects', '[]'::jsonb,
          'rooms', '[]'::jsonb,
          'walls', '[]'::jsonb
        )
      )
    )
    RETURNING id INTO v_settlement;
  END IF;

  IF to_regclass('public.world_place_map_links') IS NOT NULL AND v_dornhain IS NOT NULL AND v_root IS NOT NULL THEN
    INSERT INTO public.world_place_map_links (world_profile_id, place_id, map_id, usage, anchor)
    VALUES (
      p_world_profile_id, v_dornhain, v_root, 'overview',
      '{"x":360,"y":510,"source":"dornhain.unified.v3"}'::jsonb
    )
    ON CONFLICT (place_id, map_id, usage) DO UPDATE
      SET anchor = EXCLUDED.anchor;

    IF v_settlement IS NOT NULL THEN
      INSERT INTO public.world_place_map_links (world_profile_id, place_id, map_id, usage)
      VALUES (p_world_profile_id, v_dornhain, v_settlement, 'footprint')
      ON CONFLICT (place_id, map_id, usage) DO NOTHING;
    END IF;
  END IF;
END;
$$
